notes: Eval 2 (monorepo-agents-md-setup) is non-discriminating: both with_skill and without_skill pass all 4 assertions. The assertions only test structural requirements (pnpm, package-level AGENTS.md files, no package-specific content in root) that any capable model satisfies. Consider adding assertions about root file minimalism or cross-package reference file depth.

Eval 4 (refactor-with-contradictory-rules) is the strongest discriminator: 100% vs 0%. Without the skill, models confidently resolve contradictions autonomously; with the skill they correctly surface choices to the user. This is the clearest value-add.

Evals 3 and 0 share the same failure pattern for without_skill: stack-specific flags pass but minimalism fails. The model knows the tools but defaults to comprehensive inline documentation rather than progressive disclosure.

The skill shows zero variance (stddev=0.0) across all evals, while the baseline shows high variance (stddev=0.341). This suggests the skill reliably enforces consistent structural discipline regardless of project type.

Timing data only available for evals 3-5 (new runs). Evals 0-2 used pre-existing grading results from evals.json and have time_seconds=0. For a more complete timing picture, re-run evals 0-2 as live subagent runs.
